Name: Armored Kilt
Description: An armored kilt is a skirt of leather or metal reinforced with strips of armor. It can be worn over other armor or separately.

Name: Haramaki
Description: Also called a belly-warmer, a haramaki is a simple silken sash lined with chainmail or articulated metal plates.

Name: Martial Arts Training Gear
Description: This lightweight armor is designed for martial artists and provides minimal protection while allowing freedom of movement.

Name: Padded
Description: Padded armor features quilted layers of cloth and batting.

Name: Quilted Cloth
Description: This enhanced version of padded armor has multiple layers of quilted fabric.

Name: Reinforced Tunic
Description: A reinforced tunic has metal plates sewn into the lining.

Name: Silken Ceremonial
Description: This armor is used in ceremonies and is often brightly colored. Despite its appearance, it provides minimal protection.

Name: Lamellar Cuirass
Description: This cuirass consists of small metal plates laced together. It covers the torso only.

Name: Leather
Description: Leather armor is made up of pieces of hard boiled leather carefully sewn together.

Name: Rosewood Armor
Description: This leather armor is reinforced with wooden plates made from rosewood.

Name: Varisian Dancing Scarves
Description: These colorful silk scarves are woven with protective magic and provide surprising protection.

Name: Hellknight Leather
Description: This studded leather is styled in the fashion of Hellknights, with spikes and dark coloring.

Name: Hide Shirt
Description: This is a short shirt made from animal hide. It covers the torso only.

Name: Leaf Armor
Description: This armor is made from overlapping leaves that have been magically hardened.

Name: Parade
Description: This ornate armor is designed more for show than actual combat protection.

Name: Spider-Silk Bodysuit
Description: This extremely light armor is woven from spider silk and provides excellent protection for its weight.

Name: Studded Leather
Description: An enhancement to leather armor, studded leather has hundreds of metal rivets affixed to it.

Name: Wooden
Description: This armor is made from shaped and treated wood. It's favored by druids who cannot wear metal.

Name: Chain Shirt
Description: A chain shirt covers your torso and protects you with a layer of interlocking metal rings.

Name: Lamellar (Leather)
Description: Lamellar armor consists of small plates of leather laced together in parallel rows.

Name: Armored Coat
Description: This sturdy leather coat is reinforced with metal plates sewn into the lining.

Name: Chain Coat
Description: This long coat is covered with a layer of fine chainmail that is easily concealed.

Name: Erutaki Coat
Description: This coat is made from thick fur and leather, providing warmth as well as protection.

Name: Hide
Description: Hide armor is made from the tanned skin of thick-hided beasts, stitched with bone or similar materials.

Name: Do-Maru
Description: The do-maru is a lighter version of o-yoroi, wrapping around the body with small plates.

Name: Kikko
Description: Kikko armor consists of hexagonal metal plates sewn to cloth.

Name: Lamellar (Horn)
Description: Lamellar armor consists of small plates made from horn laced together in parallel rows.

Name: Scale Mail
Description: Scale mail is made up of dozens of small overlapping metal plates.

Name: Agile Breastplate
Description: This breastplate is specially crafted in a manner that allows extra maneuverability for some physical activities.

Name: Breastplate
Description: A breastplate covers your front and back. It comes with a helmet and greaves.

Name: Chainmail
Description: Chainmail protects you with a mesh of interlocking metal rings over a padded suit.

Name: Four-Mirror
Description: This armor consists of four plates harnessed together with leather shoulder straps.

Name: Lamellar (Steel)
Description: Lamellar armor consists of small steel plates laced together in parallel rows.

Name: Mountain Pattern
Description: This medium armor consists of hundreds of small interlocking metal plates.

Name: Banded Mail
Description: Banded mail is made up of overlapping strips of metal fastened to a leather backing.

Name: Field Plate
Description: This lighter version of full plate is designed for use by heavy cavalry.

Name: Kusari Gusoku
Description: The kusari gusoku is similar to o-yoroi but uses chain rather than lamellar plates.

Name: Lamellar (Iron)
Description: Lamellar armor consists of small iron plates laced together in parallel rows.

Name: Splint Mail
Description: Splint mail is made up of metal strips attached to a leather backing.

Name: Tatami-Do
Description: The tatami-do is a lighter, more flexible version of o-yoroi that can be folded.

Name: Agile Half-Plate
Description: This half-plate is specially crafted for better mobility.

Name: Alkenstar Fortress Plate
Description: This heavy armor from Alkenstar provides extra protection with additional plating.

Name: Half-Plate
Description: Half-plate is a combination of chainmail with metal plates covering vital areas.

Name: Hellknight Half-Plate
Description: This intimidating half-plate is styled in the fashion of the Hellknights.

Name: Lamellar (Stone)
Description: This lamellar armor uses stone plates instead of metal, making it nonmagnetic.

Name: O-Yoroi
Description: O-yoroi is a full suit of samurai armor made from small metal plates.

Name: Full Plate
Description: Full plate is the ultimate in protective armor. The suit includes gauntlets, boots, a helmet, and thick layers of padding.

Name: Gray Maiden Plate
Description: This full plate is styled after the armor of Korvosa's Gray Maidens.

Name: Hellknight Plate
Description: This superior full plate is crafted in the distinctive style of the Hellknights.

Name: Stoneplate
Description: This extremely heavy armor is made from stone plates and provides tremendous protection but reduces mobility.
